script.source: HyperSpeedInit and HyperSpeedTerm in tempmods.py set and clear kHyperSpeed. The entilsar lastday2 capture supplies the 600-second bonus and +0.45 MovementScale. Object12 stores the corresponding observer and creation fields.
script.runtime: AbilityBuffs preserves the captured owner update, stores the active scale, sends it to existing observers and clears it at removal. Player creation includes the nonzero scale and current presentation mask.
script.test: The ability-parity-awakened-mobility disposable uses the full stock ability request, sees the timed +45 record and observer scale, brings a late observer in, and verifies the dismissal resets both observers.

script.source: GOB 13 schedules PlayHyperStrengthFX at three seconds with effect 0x280009d7 and ISDrainWithAbilityDeactivation at five seconds with value 25. Its shipped character prerequisite is 99.
script.runtime: The activation's guarded lifetime schedules its periodic effect separately from the existing drain. Dismissal and drain shortfall retire the same activation and prevent later effects.
script.test: The ability-parity-awakened-mobility disposable seeds 13 only for an explicitly forced profile, uses the ordinary 43-byte request, sees repeated FX and the live drain, then verifies switch-off. BuffDrainLifetimeTests.HyperStrengthEmitsItsOwnPeriodicEffectAndStopsAfterDrainShortfall verifies exact effect, learned melee damage, debit and shortfall cleanup.
